title: Costco's Co-Founder Threatened His CEO #shorts
summary: As former CEO Craig Jelinek told it, Costco's co-founder Jim Sinegal refused to let the hot dog price go up.
sources: Jim Sinegal quote as recalled by Craig Jelinek (425 Business, via Yahoo): https://ca.news.yahoo.com/costco-raising-membership-fee-first-191136748.html

scenes.narration: Costco's co-founder once threatened his CEO over a hot dog.
The CEO said they were losing money on it. The answer: if you raise the effing hot dog, I will kill you. Figure it out.

data.quote: If you raise the [effing] hot dog, I will kill you. *Figure it out.*
data.note: as recalled by CEO Craig Jelinek (2018)

scenes.narration: They figured it out. It still costs {$1.50.|a dollar fifty.}
Because that hot dog protects five billion dollars a year in membership fees.
